extracted.intended_audience: consumers looking to download or evaluate the Hulu streaming app on Windows, Android, iOS, smart TVs and web
extracted.subtask_description: Informational product page describing Hulu's features, compatibility, pricing, and competitive positioning for users considering downloading or subscribing. Focuses on what Hulu offers (library, live TV, DVR), device support, geographic availability, and alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content library breadth (on-demand)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu is mostly a huge streaming library with tons of episodes and movies to watch at will. TV shows, Hollywood movies, documentaries, animation, etc.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates the amount and variety of on-demand content available (network TV shows, movies, documentaries, animation). The page emphasizes being able to watch episodes and movies 'at will' and that users can find entertainment across genres from drama to comedy and documentaries to reality shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live TV streaming and channel availability
rubrics_metrics.description: “What sets Hulu apart from the competition is its specific offer of live TV streaming. User can watch more than 95 channels (national et local) directly from their Hulu + TV subscription and in the Hulu App. The channels include the famous ESPN+ for fans of live sports.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures whether live TV is offered, number and types of channels included (national and local), and availability of premium sports channels like ESPN+. Highlights Hulu + Live TV as a distinguishing feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: DVR functionality and retention window
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu offers a DVR option. The DVR (Digital Video Recorder) content is available up to nine months after its broadcast. You can then watch any of these videos at your convenience. All are available immediately after their broadcast.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses presence and practical utility of DVR features: how long recorded content is retained (up to nine months), immediacy of availability after broadcast, and convenience for catching missed shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness of episode availability (new episodes)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Users avoid waiting for season drops because Hulu allows instant access to new episodes of shows. The streaming experience lets you remain updated about new premieres, just like cable subscribers, without having to return to that subscription.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers whether new network episodes are available promptly (instant access) rather than waiting for full-season releases; important for viewers who want latest episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original content quality and distinctiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu delivers compelling original content that occasionally surprises users, even though it does not receive the same level of praise as other platforms. Hulu provides a refreshing experience by featuring shows which have yet to take over social media platforms.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates Hulu's originals: originality, ability to surprise or stand out, and relative critical/social media impact compared with other services.

rubrics_metrics.name: User interface and recommendation behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: “The system functions effortlessly. The platform design is both minimalistic and uncluttered, while keeping the recommendation suggestions to a minimum.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses UI design quality (minimalistic, uncluttered), ease of use, and the aggressiveness or subtlety of recommendation algorithms and suggestions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability for sports and local-channel viewers (Hulu + Live TV importance)
rubrics_metrics.description: “It becomes essential for live sports fans and local channel viewers to invest in the Hulu + Live TV plan for their entertainment needs. Hulu + Live TV provides a solution to keep viewers from returning to classic cable television services.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rates how well Hulu (particularly the Live TV plan) replaces cable for sports and local channels; whether it meets needs of viewers who prioritize live broadcasts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-device compatibility and platform support
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu is available on smart TV, mobile platforms (Android, iOS) and on the web... Users can stream their content across mobile phones and TVs as well as laptops and gaming consoles through the Hulu service. ... Hulu allows users to access its services from mobile iOS and Android devices and Windows 10/11. Of course, you can also access Hulu via its website on any browser. Users can access the application through all major smart TVs, as well as Roku and Amazon Fire TV and Chromecast systems, along with gaming consoles such as Xbox and PlayStation.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks supported operating systems and devices (Windows 10/11, Android, iOS, web browsers, smart TVs, Roku, Fire TV, Chromecast, Xbox, PlayStation) and whether streaming works smoothly across these platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic availability and regional distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu is not for everyone: the service is only available in the US (in Europe for example the Hulu programs are included in the Disney+ subscription). ... Note that Hulu is only available in the US. If you are in another region of the world, you won’t be able to access the platform.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether the service is available in a user’s country and notes regional alternatives or distribution differences (e.g., Hulu content in Europe being included with Disney+).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing plans, trial availability, and adaptability
rubrics_metrics.description: “The Hulu service includes various price plans, but it does not provide 100% free access... Hulu gives each customer a seven-day free trial period... The pricing options of this platform are adaptable according to the users’ needs. Any budget can find an appropriate pricing plan on Hulu that serves its purpose, whether users require occasional show streaming or complete cable replacement.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses cost structure (multiple plans), presence and length of free trial (7 days), and flexibility of plans to meet different budgets and use cases (occasional streaming vs cable replacement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Profiles and watchlist personalization for families
rubrics_metrics.description: “For families, it is possible to create different profiles through Hulu to prevent their watch records from mixing with those of the others, and keep each their own watch list.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers support for multiple user profiles, separation of watch histories and personalized watchlists for household members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update recency and app ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifications list: Play Store 3.9 (1,561,458 Votes), App Store 4.6 (1,429,437 Votes), Last update May 4, 2026, License: Trial version.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses app store ratings, number of votes, and last update date as signals of app quality, popularity, and maintenance frequency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative strengths and alternatives positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: The page outlines alternatives and how they differ: Prime Video (bundled with Prime, expanding originals), Netflix (massive library, global/international content, season-based releases), Disney+ (Disney-owned catalog, Marvel/Star Wars/Pixar, includes Hulu content in Europe).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates Hulu relative to competitors on aspects like global reach, original content focus, interface, and integration with other services; useful when choosing between platforms based on priorities (originals, international content, bundled services).

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations / anti-patterns (what Hulu lacks)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hulu is not for everyone... the service is only available in the US... it does not provide 100% free access... [originals] does not receive the same level of praise as other platforms.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flags key downsides: geographic restriction to the US, absence of a fully free tier, and originals that may be less acclaimed than some competitors—important when weighing trade-offs.
